payload.text: After WP13 lands, before minting its AT rows: at lint needs each cited file to carry its AT's literal id (dc, for AT-02.2). Add them in one small comment-only commit, measured: 'AT-00.7' on the AC-00.7 test in tests/pplr_core.bats; 'AT-00.4' on every_golden_of_a_ported_command_replays in tests/cli.rs (today it appears only in AT-00.2's doc comment); and AT-00.3's cited file (tools/bats-rust, or tests.yml beside its 'ST0001 AT-02.1', which must stay). AT-00.1, 00.2, 00.6 and 00.9 already carry theirs. Then: AC-01.3 reworded, AC-02.2 withdrawn with AT-02.2 n/a (vc decision 12), AT-00.1 to 00.9 minted with their measured reds and greens, wp gate, wp done.
